raw_delta_model.description: Per-side unwrapped raw_rotation angle change to gripper width change. Recovery uses vision as an absolute anchor only when the visual fit is reliable; otherwise vision is a motion consistency check.
raw_delta_model.raw_wrap_handling: Angles are unwrapped before all fitting and recovery so 359->0 and 0->359 crossings are continuous.

visual_delta_model.description: Per-side wrist-view gap change to gripper width change. Recovery uses this for visual-primary repair when the visual motion is reliable.
